34138478.source: At day 28, the median number of days alive without life support in the hydrocortisone vs placebo group were 7 vs 10 (adjusted mean difference: -1.1 days, 95% CI -9.5 to 7.3, P = .79); mortality was 6/16 vs 2/14; and the number of serious adverse reactions 1/16 vs 0/14.
34138478.verification: Direct serious-adverse-reaction fractions at day 28; matches the harm specification keywords and randomized hydrocortisone/placebo arms. Outcome identity: the trial's prespecified composite of serious adverse REACTIONS at day 14 (new septic shock, invasive fungal infection, clinically important GI bleeding, anaphylactic reaction; full text PMC8441888), not all-cause serious adverse events, so it is served as its own outcome and is not pooled with SAE. Decided by Dispatch under Mahmood's delegation, 25 Sep 2026 (evid2 signature queue Q3; evidence/typed_arms/witness/DECISIONS_2026-09-25.md). Served-result change: derived notice D-Q3 on the signing list.
34138478.outcome: Serious adverse reactions (septic shock, invasive fungal infection, GI bleeding, anaphylaxis; day 14)
